## Pyre STOS rigid transform UI

Before changing rigid translate, rotate, zoom, or composite/warped alignment display in `nornir-pyre`,
read `.cursor/skills/pyre-stos-rigid-transform-ui/SKILL.md`. It is authoritative for:

- Expected behavior per view (source / target / composite; see Pyre-coordinate-spaces)
- **Rigid rotation is Composite-only** (`rigid_rotation_locked`)
- **Model-authoritative display** via `RigidDisplayStrategy.resolve_draw_state`
- Interactive-edit layer freeze (gesture snapshot, not overlay matrices)
- Cross-view sync invariants

**Do not** patch one panel in isolation without checking the display strategy rules for all three views.

When you change display-state lifecycle (new gestures, strategy hooks, or shader uniforms), update the skill and `nornir-pyre/docs/adding_transform_display_strategy.md` in the same change set.
